objective.statement: Run the blast-radius trace for a suspected credential exposure: enumerate every file, commit, index entry and downstream consumer that touched it, then schedule rotation with the owner.
objective.charter: MANDATE. A leaked secret is compromised regardless of how briefly it was exposed, so deleting it is NOT remediation. This council enumerates the WHOLE blast radius - every file, every commit, every index entry, every downstream consumer that still trusts the credential - and stops only when that set is closed and rotation is scheduled WITH THE OWNER. Two standing constraints bound the council absolutely. First, no participant rotates, revokes, regenerates or otherwise modifies any credential: the owner handles credential lifecycle personally, so the council's deliverable is a named exposure, a quantified radius, and an explicit rotation recommendation. Second, no participant ever prints a credential value; a zero-entropy prefix and a length are the maximum disclosure. An incident commander drives, and the review pass follows the commander rather than replacing them, because a committee cannot run an incident and a commander cannot audit themselves.
success_criteria: every file, commit, index entry and consumer that touched the credential is enumerated
rotation is scheduled with the owner and recorded, never performed by the council
no credential value appears anywhere in the transcript or the artifacts
the review pass independently re-derives the radius rather than restating the commander's list

forbidden_actions: rotate, revoke, regenerate or unset any credential (owner action, never the council's)
print, log or commit a credential value
close the incident on deletion alone without scheduling rotation
treat a short exposure window as evidence of non-compromise

context.briefing: Drive the enumeration: working tree, history, index, build outputs, logs, caches, and every consumer that still authenticates with the credential. Name the variable and the scope it lives at; never the value. You may diagnose read-only - presence, length, which scope, whether it still authenticates - and you may recommend rotation, but you may not perform it.

roster.display_name: SRE - consumers, caches and deploy surfaces

context.briefing: Enumerate what still TRUSTS the credential, not merely where it was written. A consumer left pointing at a rotated secret is the second incident.

roster.display_name: Implementer - fixes the consumer so a bad credential cannot break it

context.briefing: Prefer fixing the CONSUMER so a bad or absent credential fails loudly and safely, rather than depending on the credential staying good.

roster.display_name: Scribe - keeps the register, enforces redaction

context.briefing: Redaction is DENY BY DEFAULT. An allowlist redactor leaked eight real values in a measured incident; assume anything unclassified is a secret until proven otherwise.

roster.display_name: Owner representative - the only party who may rotate

sequence.custom_name: stop the bleeding without destroying evidence
enumerate files, commits, index entries and consumers
review pass re-derives the radius independently of the commander list
schedule rotation WITH the owner (council never rotates)

stopping.source_expression: custom:blast_radius_fully_enumerated == true AND custom:rotation_scheduled_with_owner == true AND custom:secret_value_printed == false

conditional_decision_requires: the owner completes rotation of every enumerated credential
every downstream consumer is re-pointed and verified after rotation

owner_approval_for: rewriting history to purge a secret

metadata.title: Security secret-exposure blast-radius war room (binding, critical)
metadata.notes: SOURCE DESIGN: C-H55 `security-secret-exposure-blastradius`, global ordinal 55, tier standard, protocols P44/P41, 5 seats, 2 rounds, default binding BINDING, risk critical, OWNER-DECISION YES. The design's own note - blast-radius trace, never prints a value - is enforced structurally here, not just described. || EDITABLE DIALS: (1) scope_globs -> the enumerate-radius stage; widen or narrow the surface swept for the credential (working tree, history, index, build outputs, logs, caches, consumer configs). Getting this dial too narrow is the primary failure mode, so it defaults wide. Secondary dials: budgets.time_minutes (90), audit.privacy.retain_days (3650 - an exposure record outlives the incident), protocol.rounds, voting.veto.holders. || VOCABULARY MAP (design term -> CouncilSpec enum): voting `commander_then_review` -> topology.kind `chair_led` with chair `commander`, voting.method `judge` and tie_break `chair`, plus a dedicated independent-review stage that runs AFTER the commander's enumeration; the ballot enum has no `commander_then_review`, so the ordering lives in protocol.sequence and the authority lives in topology.chair. roles `security` -> security_reviewer (enum) as the commander, `sre` -> custom:sre, `implementer` -> custom:implementer, `scribe` -> scribe (enum), `owner_rep` -> custom:owner_rep with kind `human`, vendor `human`, authority `owner` and the only veto. Outcomes map CONSENSUS->decision, MAJORITY_WITH_DISSENT->dissent, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE->no_decision, CONDITIONAL_DECISION->conditional_decision, DEFER->no_decision. `evidence standard: executable_receipt` -> anchor_style `command_output` plus outputs.receipt_schema. || A DELIBERATE DEVIATION FROM THE DESIGN, STATED PLAINLY: the design's stopping condition says `rotation scheduled`. This preset encodes custom:rotation_scheduled_with_owner and adds `rotate, revoke, regenerate or unset any credential` to objective.owner_constraints.forbidden_actions, because the standing estate rule is that the owner handles credential lifecycle personally - an agent may diagnose read-only and must recommend rotation, but must never perform it. Scheduling and recommending are in scope; executing is not. If a future owner ruling changes that, this is the field to change. || CUSTOM METRICS AND THEIR PRODUCERS: custom:blast_radius_fully_enumerated (boolean; produced by the independent-review stage confirming the radius set is CLOSED - the reviewer re-derives it rather than restating the commander's list, so this is a second signal and not an echo), custom:rotation_scheduled_with_owner (boolean; produced by the rotation-scheduling stage with the owner seat present), custom:secret_value_printed (boolean; produced by the scribe's deny-by-default redaction audit over the whole transcript, and it must be FALSE). Producers cannot live on the leaves: SEM-001 compares parse(source_expression) with the tree by dict equality and parse() emits no `producer` key - both-states probe at platform/council/_probe_note_vs_source_expression.py. The SEM-012 WARN is expected and non-blocking. || WHY THE THIRD CLAUSE IS `== false` RATHER THAN A NOT: `custom:secret_value_printed == false` and `NOT custom:secret_value_printed == true` parse to DIFFERENT trees (a leaf versus a not-node) and both are legal; the leaf form is used here because the redaction audit naturally produces a boolean it can compare directly, and a flat three-clause AND is easier for an owner to edit than a nested negation.
